# Agent Rank Radar

> Agent Rank Radar is the 24/7 radar for your AI answer visibility — it tracks how often ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity mention a company versus its competitors when answering buyer-intent questions, and turns the gaps into a prioritized content plan.

Agent Rank Radar generates hundreds of realistic buyer-intent prompts for a company's category (e.g. "best project management software for remote teams"), runs them daily against OpenAI's, Anthropic's, Google's, and Perplexity's live models, and scores the results into an AI Visibility Score, a per-engine breakdown, and a competitor comparison. It also analyzes which sources (Reddit, G2, Trustpilot, blogs) the models actually cite, and recommends specific pages to publish or update to close visibility gaps.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://agentrankradar.com/pricing): Three plans — Starter ($29/mo, 1 project), Growth ($99/mo, 3 projects, daily refresh), Agency ($299/mo, unlimited client projects, white-label reports). All plans include a 3-day free trial with no credit card required.
- [Agency Mode](https://agentrankradar.com/agency): Multi-client AI visibility tracking for agencies and consultants, with white-label reports.

## How it works

- [AI Search SEO Guide](https://agentrankradar.com/ai-search-seo): A practical guide to AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — how to get cited by AI models, not just ranked on Google.
- [ChatGPT Ranking Checker](https://agentrankradar.com/chatgpt-ranking-checker): How Agent Rank Radar checks whether ChatGPT recommends a given company.
- [Claude Ranking Checker](https://agentrankradar.com/claude-ranking-checker): How Agent Rank Radar checks whether Claude recommends a given company.
- [Monitor ChatGPT Mentions](https://agentrankradar.com/monitor-chatgpt-mentions): How the weekly/daily alerting works when visibility changes.
